person_updates.identity_evidence: Diana I. Croft and the immediately adjacent Diana Crofts row share the same given name, Box 154, and archival location, but neither row supplies a rank, identifier, note, or direct source that permits a merger.
person_updates.next_action: Review both Box 154 files together for matching biographical identifiers, service history, assignment, and name spelling before merging or linking any Diana Croft namesake.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The official Army merged-file row matches the exact full name and complete private identifier printed in the index. It records Army entry on 29 July 1942 as a private and occupation code 731.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 154 to establish the Army-to-OSS sequence and identify a named roofing employer or intervening affiliation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The Diana Crofts row immediately follows Diana I. Croft in Box 154 and may represent a variant or duplicate, but neither row supplies a rank, identifier, note, or direct source establishing sameness.
person_updates.next_action: Review both Box 154 files together for matching biographical identifiers, service history, assignment, and name spelling; preserve both source rows regardless of the result.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The printed index spells the surname Croliuus. Anne B. Crolius appears in later CIA and institutional-history sources, but those postwar references provide no direct OSS or Box 155 bridge proving a correction or identity match.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 155 to determine whether Croliuus is a typographical error for Crolius and whether the file belongs to later CIA historian Anne B. Crolius before adding a public name variant.
